name: ask_host
title: Ask the instance host
description: Ask this instance's host for a right or feature only the host can grant, and only after the owners agreed (ask_human). The host sees only the title and the text: no secrets, keys or client data. The answer comes as a system message, to the owners as an alert. At most five open at once.

task_key.description: The card the request is about, if any (the host does not see it).
